Container.Name: NetBird-Server
Container.Overview: Combined NetBird server — management, signal, relay, and STUN in a single container for self-hosted VPN mesh networking. Requires a config.yaml and a reverse proxy for TLS.

Config.Name: HTTP/gRPC Port
Config.Description: HTTP/gRPC API port (reverse proxy targets this)

Config.Name: STUN Port
Config.Description: STUN UDP port for NAT traversal

Config.Name: Config File
Config.Description: config.yaml — generated by NetBird's getting-started.sh script, then copied here

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent data (SQLite DB, encryption keys, state)
